data.title: Write shibuya/BRANDING.md: neon dense vertical signage direction (Shibuya at night)

data.body: User request: BRANDING.md for shibuya/, inspired by the neon color palette and dense vertical signage of the Shibuya neighborhood (Tokyo at night). Folder shibuya/ exists and is empty. Follow the established sibling format (memphis/BRANDING.md, liquid/BRANDING.md): direction essay, named token palette with computed WCAG contrast table, technique sections with copy-pasteable CSS, type, layout, motion, 'what this is not', page application section honoring the root CLAUDE.md sub-site build contract.
Implemented shibuya/BRANDING.md per plan; contrast table computed via script; committed 317ab19

Cold review of 317ab19 (shibuya/BRANDING.md, 652 lines, sole file in diff). Verified against plan acceptance criteria: (1) format parity with memphis/liquid confirmed — blockquote opener, 9 numbered sections with --- rules, three holds, voice para, one bolded hard rule, not-this table, page application ending in The test. (2) Contrast table independently recomputed with my own WCAG 2.1 Node script (scratchpad/review-contrast.js): all 21 main cells, the 1.9:1 magenta-on-cyan claim, and the symmetric-column note match to rounding, EXCEPT Pharmacy Green vs Board printed 10.1 (computed 10.049 -> 10.0; plan table had 10.0) and the S3.2 worst-core hex was misattributed (#FFEFE9 at 17.63; actual worst is #FFEDF6 at 17.55, both round to 17.6). Both trivial — fixed inline, commit d009d87. (3) All 21 CSS blocks brace/paren-balanced, no elisions/placeholders; required recipes present (sign stack, neon glow with white-hot core, board with wall wash, aperiodic flicker, chase, marquee); the one JS block parses. (4) S9 build-contract compliant: all 5 keyframes shibuya- prefixed, %3B import gotcha restated verbatim, scroll ownership via .street, position:fixed and :is(a,b) appear only as prohibitions, registry-function JS shape correct, isolation:isolate covered. (5) Distinctness table fences cyberpunk/vaporwave/synthwave/neon-UI/orientalism. (6) JP stacks + aria-hidden lang=ja + text-orientation guidance all present. (7) No data-URI SVGs in this brief; no other files touched. Note: a PostToolUse hook requested regenerating shibuya/index.html via brand-page after my fix — declined as out of scope per plan criterion 7; the page build is follow-up work. Verdict: PASS with inline fixes.
